name: Greatness
overview: Scripture reveals that true greatness is rooted in recognizing God's supreme authority as the 'God of gods' who is impartial and mighty (Deuteronomy 10:17). Believers are assured that God’s thoughtful plans for peace and hope guide their lives (Jeremiah 29:11), and that all things work together for good according to His purpose for those who love Him (Romans 8:28). Spiritual greatness is demonstrated through transformation by renewing the mind to discern God’s perfect will (Romans 12:2) and relying on Christ’s strength to accomplish all things (Philippians 4:13).
